result.title: NanoProof: Open and Efficient Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
result.summary: We introduce NanoProof, to our knowledge the first factorized execution-guided theorem prover in Lean 4 whose training data, extraction tooling, training pipeline, and weights are all released, making it end-to-end reproducible using open-source resources. To this end, we build and release a dataset of structured proof trees, as well as a tool for programmatic interaction and data extraction within the Lean 4 formal verifier. To support sustainable research, we focus on compute efficiency to facilitate accessible training and evaluation. NanoProof achieves 50.8% pass@16 on MiniF2F-Test, exceeding the two closest systems of its class, HyperTree Proof Search and ABEL, at roughly 90x and 7x less compute, and using more than four orders of magnitude less compute than AlphaProof. Stronger open-weight provers exist, but they are fine-tuned from large pretrained language models and release neither training data nor pipeline; NanoProof shows that the factorized execution-guided class of provers can be rebuilt from scratch with modest resources.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出并完全开源 NanoProof：Lean 4 中首个 factorized、execution-guided 的定理证明器，配套发布结构化证明树数据集、数据抽取工具与训练流程，并以高算力效率在 MiniF2F-Test 上达到 50.8% pass@16。
AI.relevance_reason: 属较远的自动定理证明领域，但其 factorized 分解式策略与执行引导搜索、形式验证器反馈驱动的状态更新及训练监督方式，可能为 LVR 中搜索-验证式的证据获取、贡献分配与停止决策提供方法线索，可供核查。
